title: Latvia takes charge of the United Nations Security Council for first time
summary_full: November 1st, 2026 is an historic day, as for the first time ever Latvia will hold the presidency of the UN Security Council (UNSC). During this month, Latvia will chair all informal and formal UNSC meetings.
